"""Derive corrected method labels without changing any scientific record or array."""
import copy,hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V172-local-noise-matching-v1';plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');old=read(root/'scores-v1.json');training=read(root/'train-result-v1.json');audit=read(root/'training-audit-v1.json')
assert old['checkpoint']==training['final_checkpoint'] and old['plan']==ref(root/'plan-v1.json')
assert old['module_hashes']['raw']['before']==audit['raw_module_hash'] and old['module_hashes']['EMA']['before']==audit['EMA_module_hash']
assert len(old['rows'])==1644 and {r['method'] for r in old['rows']}=={'V171-raw','V171-EMA'}
assert plan['methods']==['V172-raw','V172-EMA']
mapping={f'V171-{e}{suffix}':f'V172-{e}{suffix}' for e in ['raw','EMA'] for suffix in ['','-correction']}
new=copy.deepcopy(old)
for row in new['rows']+new['summary']:row['method']=mapping[row['method']]
for identifier,bindings in new['native_predictions'].items():
 assert len(bindings)==4
 for binding in bindings.values():
  assert Path(binding['path']).is_relative_to(Path(plan['external'])/'native') and ref(binding['path'])==binding
 new['native_predictions'][identifier]={mapping[k]:v for k,v in bindings.items()}
assert len(new['native_predictions'])==36
reverse={v:k for k,v in mapping.items()};restored=copy.deepcopy(new)
for row in restored['rows']+restored['summary']:row['method']=reverse[row['method']]
for identifier,bindings in restored['native_predictions'].items():restored['native_predictions'][identifier]={reverse[k]:v for k,v in bindings.items()}
assert restored==old
out=root/'scores-method-labels-v2.json';assert not out.exists();save(out,new)
receipt=root/'method-label-normalization-v2.json';assert not receipt.exists()
save(receipt,dict(status='labels-only-derived-view-of-preserved-V172-records',original=ref(root/'scores-v1.json'),normalized=ref(out),mapping=mapping,rows=1644,native_cases=36,unchanged_native_array_bindings=144,all_other_record_fields_exact=True,roundtrip_exact=True,training=ref(root/'train-result-v1.json'),endpoint_audit=ref(root/'training-audit-v1.json'),frozen_runner=plan['runner'],current_runner=ref(repo/'scripts/train_local_noise_matching_trial.py'),source=dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),new_neural_forwards=0,new_source_noise_draws=0))
print('Mapped1644 method labels/144 native keys;roundtrip exact;no arrays or original records altered')
